purpose: Move off the heights question and see how terrain gets drawn, which is where the sand sketch needs to go.

pages.title: Terrain cartography
pages.reaction: Terrain cartography is a lot of people finding clever ways to make a bumpy surface readable on flat paper. Hachures, Tanaka contours, plan oblique relief, all trying to fake light on a hill. The sand sketch needs the multi-direction lighting trick, that much is clear, and the stark plastic-shading complaint is exactly the moonscape problem I have on my hands.
